[P3] Revisit the independent release-version policy

CONTRIBUTING rule 2, “Simplify before you add,” requires explaining simpler alternatives, and rule 7 requires listing additional decisions and their reasons. The PR description explains neither this separate parser nor the major-version restriction. The parser rejects `1.1.0-rc.1+build.7`, although the publisher’s existing `parseSemver` explicitly supports build metadata and tests it. Because publishing runs the full test suite, this assertion blocks an otherwise supported release even when the manifest and lockfile agree. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6; consider the existing release policy as the simpler direction and document any additional constraints for maintainer agreement.
